Welcome to the AEIS wiki. If this is your first time here, please read the AEIS group [Induction](induction.qmd) guide. Otherwise, explore the different sections below:

- [Induction](induction.qmd): Group induction guide.
- [Data](data.qmd): Our datasets, data pipelines, and storage guidelines for group research projects.
- [Tools](tools.qmd): Documentation and tutorials for the software packages, models, scripts, and computational tools developed/used by group members.
- [Papers](papers.qmd): Some important research papers.
- [Writing](writing.qmd): Best practices for writing and other things.
- [Courses](courses.qmd): Courses available at Imperial and our reviews.
- [Sustainability](sustainability.qmd): AEIS sustainability practices.
- [Group Meetings](group-meetings.qmd): General guidelines for group meeting presentations, journal club discussions, and more.
